product_from_film: Bustem presents an AI and human team that finds suspected brand copying and seeks enforcement against stores, payments and ads.
explains_well: A clothing example explains indexing brand images, searching for copies and comparing a suspected stolen photograph.
unclear: The film jumps from a photo match to dramatic shutdown claims without showing the review, report or platform decision for that case.
scenario: Find suspected copies of a clothing brand’s images and pursue enforcement.
product_clear_basis: The presenter names an AI enforcement team and the counterfeit-removal promise.

lessons.keep: Use one enlarged visual detail to explain why an item was flagged.
lessons.avoid: Avoid presenting a suspected match and a final enforcement decision as the same step.
lessons.open: Case review, authorization status, actual takedowns, absolute performance claims and all heard audio remain unverified.
try: For Tin, show the precise mismatch behind a campaign warning, then the user’s review.
Carry one item ID through proposed action, approval and confirmed result instead of switching to abstract success effects.
